implement_LogService: implement a concrete subclass of LogService that overrides fetch and get_log_path methods
override_fetch_method: override the fetch method to retrieve log events from a custom log source by log path and start time
override_get_log_path_method: override get_log_path to return the log file path for a given ContainerInstance
review_LogService_abstract_class: review the LogService abstract base class and its two abstract methods fetch and get_log_path
test_LogService_subclass: test a LogService subclass by calling fetch with a log path and start time to return LogEvent list
